findings.title: Reminders without a recipient never reach the retry limit
findings.body: When `sendTo` is missing (for example, an attendee reminder has no SMS number), this condition skips scheduling and neither branch increments `retryCount`. The reminder remains unscheduled and is selected by every subsequent cron run, so the new retry limit does not clean up this common failure case and the reminder is retried indefinitely.
